findings.claim_text: Taking both sources at face value, Opus 5 costs about 61× more per DeepSWE attempt.
DeepSeek's own number is 42.3 against Opus 5's 51.8, a 9.5-point deficit[^1].
DeepSeek defines peak as "01:00 - 04:00 and 06:00 - 10:00 UTC, Monday through Friday, excluding Chinese public holidays," and says "off-peak rates are half of the peak rates"[^3].
